# Last Planner Julz Funeral Planning Hub

> Funeral planning, memorial products, transport coordination, and family support from Kahawa West, serving families across Kenya.

- [Obituaries](https://funeralhome-api.onrender.com/obituaries): Public obituary and remembrance listings.
- [Catalog](https://funeralhome-api.onrender.com/catalog): Funeral and memorial products and services.
- [Privacy](https://funeralhome-api.onrender.com/privacy): Privacy information and contact details.
- [Terms](https://funeralhome-api.onrender.com/terms): Website terms.
- [Refund policy](https://funeralhome-api.onrender.com/refunds): Cancellation and refund information.
